meta.title: teri — Wedding Invites, Crafted with Care
meta.description: Designer wedding website templates with elegant typography, RSVPs, galleries and your own domain. Choose a template, make it yours, share with grace.

list.title: Your own address
list.body: Claim a personal link — yourname.teri.com.et — or bring your own domain.

list.title: Beautiful RSVPs
list.body: Collect responses, dietary notes, and song requests in one elegant inbox.

list.title: Shared galleries
list.body: Guests upload photos to a private gallery you keep forever.

list.title: Your story, told well
list.body: Timeline, vows, and dedications — written in typography that respects them.

list.title: Live the day
list.body: Live updates on the day itself — schedule changes, weather, transport.

list.title: Effortless edits
list.body: Change anything in seconds. Designed to feel like a calm, considered ritual.

faq.heading: Things couples often
faq.aside: Still wondering about something? Start with a template — it's free, and you can change your mind at any point.

items.q: How long does it take to build my wedding website?
items.a: Pick a template, add your wedding details and photos, then share your link. It only takes a few minutes.

items.q: Will guests need an account to RSVP?
items.a: No. Guests open your link and let you know if they’re coming.

items.q: Can we change the design after publishing?
items.a: Yes. You can update the design, photos and details anytime. Your link stays the same.

items.q: Is there a limit to the number of guests?
items.a: The paid plan has no guest limit. The free plan is for trying things out and expires after one day.

items.q: What happens to our website after the wedding?
items.a: Your site stays online, so you can revisit your photos and memories after the wedding.

steps.title: Pick a template
steps.body: Choose a design that feels like you. Every template is bilingual and made for phones first.

steps.title: Add your details
steps.body: Names, date, venue, your story. Change anything, any time — even after you've shared it.

steps.title: Share one link
steps.body: Send it on Telegram, WhatsApp or SMS. Guests RSVP in seconds and you see every reply.
